sentence: This project builds a smartphone tool that uses photographs and a thermal image of a wound to detect infections and recommend care.
This project builds methods to find somatic mutations that drive clonal expansions in human tissue and maps them to molecular phenotypes.
This project studies how naïve T cells become helper T cells in different human populations, and how genetics and environment shape those differences.
This project studies how human cells use RNA to control genes and to suppress aberrant proteins derived from the genome.
This project builds methods and software that use human population genetics to find rare recessive genetic factors behind disease.
This project uses deep learning to analyze the electrocardiogram during cardiopulmonary resuscitation and predict how patients respond to treatment.
This project tests a nanoparticle form of DNA as an HIV vaccine and compares it with an RNA vaccine to see how each builds immunity.
This project studies how the cortex, cerebellum, basal ganglia and brainstem control the tongue when mice lick at a spout.
This project studies how clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential relates to chronic disease, mobility impairment and exceptional longevity in older women.
This project uses machine learning to study how body mass index affects lung function over time in survivors of the terrorist attacks.
This project builds and tests a smartphone-based protocol to spot real-time suicide risk in adolescents responding to everyday stressors.
This project builds recombinant antiviral restrictors to stop the replication of viruses that spread from mosquitoes to humans.
This project uses machine learning and object detection to automatically evaluate physical protein models and give real-time feedback.
This project studies how environmental endocrine disruptors and other chemicals may affect the development of breast cancer.
This project runs mass spectrometry services for proteomics, metabolomics and lipidomics measurements in cancer research.
This project studies how cortical and subcortical brain regions control the stopping of movement, using a motor control task and brain recordings.
This project studies how state-level educational contexts affect genetic susceptibility to cognitive impairment and dementia.
This project creates videos, a webpage and an online sandbox to help cancer centers and cancer registries adopt a tool.
This project sets up a biorepository and coordinates research on Batten disease.
This project adds neonatal brain imaging to a clinical trial testing choline supplementation in heavy drinking pregnant women.
